SDG tracker for Bangladesh from the official DHS estimates

Source: R/sdg.R
bdhs_sdg.Rd

Tracks the Sustainable Development Goal indicators that the BDHS measures, using the bundled official estimates (bdhs_official()): stunting and wasting (SDG 2.2.1, 2.2.2), under-five and neonatal mortality (3.2.1, 3.2.2), skilled birth attendance (3.1.2), family planning (3.7.1), the adolescent birth rate (3.7.2), child marriage (5.3.1) and improved water and sanitation (proxies for 6.1.1, 6.2.1).

Usage

bdhs_sdg(indicators = NULL, baseline = 2014, target_year = 2030)

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_sdg'
plot(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'bdhs_sdg'
autoplot(object, ...)

Arguments

indicators

Optional ids ("stunting", "u5mr", ...), SDG numbers ("3.2.1") or DHS ids to keep. NULL keeps all.

baseline

Survey reference of the baseline round for the AARC (default 2014, the round closest to the start of the SDG period).

target_year

Target year (default 2030).

x, object

A bdhs_sdg result.

...

Unused.

Value

A tibble of class bdhs_sdg with columns id, sdg, name, dhs_id, direction, target, baseline_survey, baseline_value, latest_survey, latest_value, aarc, required_aarc, projected, on_track and target_source. The attribute series holds every round's value.

Details

  • The average annual rate of change (UNICEF/WHO) between the baseline round and the latest round is \(AARC = 1 - (x_2 / x_1)^{1 / (t_2 - t_1)}\), in percent per year, with \(t\) the mid-point of fieldwork. For indicators that should fall it is computed on the value; for coverage indicators that should rise it is computed on the shortfall \(100 - x\). Positive values always mean progress.

  • The required AARC is the rate that brings the latest value to the target by target_year; it is NA for elimination or universal targets (0% or 100%), which an exponential trend never reaches exactly.

  • The projection continues the current AARC to target_year; an indicator is on track when the target is already met or the projection, rounded to whole units, meets it.

Targets and their sources are in the target_source column; where the SDG framework has no numeric target a widely used benchmark is given, or none.

Examples

bdhs_sdg()
#> # BDHS SDG tracker (official DHS estimates) | target year 2030 | AARC in % per year
#> # A tibble: 12 × 15
#>    id         sdg   name  dhs_id direction target baseline_survey baseline_value
#>    <chr>      <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>      <dbl> <chr>                    <dbl>
#>  1 stunting   2.2.1 Stun… CN_NU… lower       20.6 BD2014DHS                 36.1
#>  2 wasting    2.2.2 Wast… CN_NU… lower        3   BD2014DHS                 14.3
#>  3 u5mr       3.2.1 Unde… CM_EC… lower       25   BD2014DHS                 46  
#>  4 nmr        3.2.2 Neon… CM_EC… lower       12   BD2014DHS                 28  
#>  5 sba        3.1.2 Birt… RH_DE… higher      90   BD2014DHS                 44.3
#>  6 demand_sa… 3.7.1 Dema… FP_NA… higher      75   BD2014DHS                 72.6
#>  7 mcpr       3.7.1 Mode… FP_CU… higher      NA   BD2014DHS                 54.1
#>  8 abr        3.7.2 Adol… FE_FR… lower       NA   BD2014DHS                113  
#>  9 married_b… 5.3.1 Wome… MA_MB… lower        0   BD2014DHS                 22.4
#> 10 married_b… 5.3.1 Wome… MA_MB… lower        0   BD2014DHS                 58.6
#> 11 improved_… 6.1.1 Popu… WS_SR… higher     100   BD2014DHS                 97.8
#> 12 improved_… 6.2.1 Popu… WS_TL… higher     100   BD2014DHS                 69.5
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: latest_survey <chr>, latest_value <dbl>, aarc <dbl>,
#> #   required_aarc <dbl>, projected <dbl>, on_track <lgl>, target_source <chr>
bdhs_sdg(c("stunting", "u5mr"))
#> # BDHS SDG tracker (official DHS estimates) | target year 2030 | AARC in % per year
#> # A tibble: 2 × 15
#>   id       sdg   name     dhs_id direction target baseline_survey baseline_value
#>   <chr>    <chr> <chr>    <chr>  <chr>      <dbl> <chr>                    <dbl>
#> 1 stunting 2.2.1 Stuntin… CN_NU… lower       20.6 BD2014DHS                 36.1
#> 2 u5mr     3.2.1 Under-f… CM_EC… lower       25   BD2014DHS                 46  
#> # ℹ 7 more variables: latest_survey <chr>, latest_value <dbl>, aarc <dbl>,
#> #   required_aarc <dbl>, projected <dbl>, on_track <lgl>, target_source <chr>
